subject: Marine Works - Grand Manan - St-Andrews, NB
text:
Marine Works - Grand Manan - St-Andrews, NB
Wharf replacement operations underway at the St-Andrews Biological Station. Operations include demolition, dredging, blasting, placement of concrete caissons and installation of docks. Equipment on site include barges, work boats, cranes and excavators. A cautionary buoy has been placed approximately 40m from the work area.
